source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for the feedback!
Our current website for the Bay Area locations, San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA, is [URL_001].
For bookings, WE USE WIX.
We are opening an additional location in Seattle WA, and it will open under the name Smash Room because our brand will be Smash Room from now on. We therefore want [URL_002] to serve as our master site, bringing our brand, locations, and information together in one place. It should include sublinks for each location while enabling every location to track its own bookings, revenue, and sales separately.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes. I also want to ensure the Seattle and Bay Area smash room operations remain separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Yes, we can set it up that way. [URL_002] will serve as the master website, where visitors can learn about your brand and select a location. If someone chooses a location such as Seattle or Bay Area, they will be directed to that location's separate Wix website to make bookings and process payments. With this arrangement, every location will have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while remaining connected through the main [URL_002] website.

value_updates.location_account_model: separate Wix account for each location

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle must use a standalone Wix account and remain entirely separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle must have separate:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

Customers should experience it as the same SMASH ROOM brand, while all backend operations remain completely independent.

Initially, Seattle should be presented as a “Coming Soon” location.

The Seattle page must follow this layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

The buttons should be:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Design the page so that when Seattle opens, booking only needs to be enabled and the photos updated, with no page redesign required.

Use the Seattle page as the template for future locations.

routing_warnings.description: The Wix limitation concerns shared payment and payout accounts; it does not conflict with the stated isolation of bookings, calendars, and reporting.
The exclusion of booking functionality from the master site changes the master site's role rather than location business-data isolation.
The booking-system installation claim concerns booking functionality and does not establish independent location data handling.
The complaint that the sites are visually identical concerns differentiation of location experiences, not backend business-data isolation.
The reversed placement of the Seattle and master sites concerns correct Wix profile and domain mapping.
